key_insights.title: Strong Positive Association: G1 and G2
key_insights.insight: G1 and G2 demonstrate a statistically significant strong positive association in the analyzed data (Spearman rho = 0.895, p < 0.001, n = 395). Higher observed values of G1 tend to correspond with higher observed values of G2.

evidence.comparison_summary: Original (Pearson and Spearman correlation matrix): stat=0.8780, p=0.0000 (N=395). Re-investigation (Spearman rank correlation): stat=0.8948, p=0.0000 (N=395). Significance consistent: True.

limitations: Observational data only; established correlation does not imply causal relationship or direction.
key_insights.practical_implication: The substantial correlation magnitude indicates a strong empirical alignment between these two features.
